question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Golden
solution:
The correct answer is **"Shining."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Golden'** means having the color or shine of gold , made of gold or bright yellow in colour like gold. (सोने का बना या सोने के रंग का)

 
 
• **Example**: *She has a **golden**__ crown.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms of** 'Golden'** include** 'shining', 'gleaming', 'gilded', 'brilliant',** etc.
 
• **'Shining'** means sending out or reflecting light or bright yellow light. (प्रकाश या चमकीली पीली रोशनी भेजना या प्रतिबिंबित करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *People described seeing a bright, **shining**__ light.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - Dull**: Opposite of **'Golden',** means lacking brightness or interest. (अरुचिकर या अनुत्तेजक; उबाऊ)

 
 
• **Option 2** - **Gloomy**: Opposite of **'Golden',** means dark and depressing. (ऐसा गहरा कि उदास कर दे)
 
• **Option 4** -** Dark**: Opposite of** 'Golden', **means without light or brightness. (अँधेरा)
